scope: owner-only local browser Profile slot provisioning
claims: the deployment command generates a 256-bit binding token into a new 0600 file and never accepts it as a command-line value
the registry stores only the binding token SHA-256 and fixes every initial local slot at version 1
provisioning and runtime version rotation share a cross-process no-follow file lock and atomic fsync/rename publication
concurrent provisioning of 16 Profiles retains all entries in deterministic order
an existing token file or conflicting Profile identity is never overwritten
